BiblicalUsage: Palmôwnîy means such a one, a certain one, so-and-so. In Daniel's vision one saint asks a certain saint how long the vision of the daily sacrifice and the transgression of desolation shall be.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even an unnamed saint has a voice in Daniel, asking how long — the question every suffering people asks.
